creativeId.title: Creative ID
creativeId.description: Unique Google Ad creative identifier (starts with CR).

advertiserName.title: Advertiser Name
advertiserName.description: Verified legal entity or company running the advertisement.

format.title: Ad Format
format.description: Format of the ad: IMAGE, TEXT, or VIDEO.

firstShown.title: First Shown Date
firstShown.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the ad was first detected.

lastShown.title: Last Shown Date
lastShown.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the ad was last detected running.

daysActive.title: Days Active
daysActive.description: Number of days between first and last seen date.

imageUrl.title: Image Asset URL
imageUrl.description: Direct CDN URL to the ad creative image (for IMAGE ads).

headline.title: Ad Headline
headline.description: Extracted headline copy for text or responsive search ads.

destinationUrl.title: Destination / Landing Page URL
destinationUrl.description: Direct landing page URL or product link promoted in the ad.

transparencyUrl.title: Transparency Center URL
transparencyUrl.description: Direct canonical link to this ad on Google Ads Transparency Center.
